item.title: Number Bonds to 10 Activities for Kindergarten: Tips for Parents
item.description: Number bonds to 10 activities for kindergarten, explained in plain words for parents. How to teach number bonds to kindergarten children: split numbers into parts with real objects, use ten frames and bond pictures, and learn bonds to 10. It also helps with ten frame activities for kindergarten and pre number activities for kids, for kids ages 4 to 8. It is free: print it or try it at sounditoutreading.com.
